Answer: B
Reason: The axial CT image (Figure 1a) clearly demonstrates an anomalous bronchus arising directly from the right lateral wall of the trachea (indicated by the yellow arrow), which is the defining feature of a right-sided accessory tracheal bronchus (pig bronchus). This congenital anomaly is frequently associated with impaired mucociliary clearance and drainage, leading to clinical complications such as recurrent infections or focal emphysema/hyperinflation in the supplied right upper lobe segment.
